summary:
DevOps Engineer with 4+ years of experience in building and managing CI/CD automation, Infrastructure as
Code (IaC), and cloud-native deployments on AWS for Fintech environments. Proficient in Kubernetes
orchestration and observability stacks using Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK. Experienced in cloud cost
optimization and improving platform reliability.

bullets: – uWSGI Metrics Exporter & Autoscaling: Developed a custom uWSGI exporter and deployed it as a sidecar container to expose RPS metrics to Prometheus, enabling KEDA-based autoscaling. – Observability with ADOT: Implemented AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry (ADOT) to collect, process, and export metrics, logs, and traces, improving observability across applications and infrastructure. – Identity & Access Management (SSO): Configured Keycloak and integrated it with Jenkins, ArgoCD, and Rancher to enable Single Sign-On (SSO), improving security posture and access governance. – Helm Standardization: Onboarded Kubernetes applications to Helm charts across development and production environments, standardizing deployments and improving release reliability through IaC-driven configuration man- agement. – Jenkins Upgrade & Migration: Migrated and upgraded Jenkins along with the underlying Ubuntu OS, im- proving system security, compatibility, and overall stability.

– Containerized Applications Deployment: Spearheaded end-to-end deployment of containerized applications using Kubernetes on AWS EKS, leveraging Helm charts and Kubernetes best practices. – Infrastructure and Cloud Migration: Successfully led the migration of infrastructure from Digital Ocean to AWS EKS, optimizing microservice deployments and improving scalability using Terraform. – CI/CD Pipeline Management: Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and ArgoCD. – Observability & Monitoring: Deployed full observability stack — ELK (Logstash, Filebeat, Kibana), Prometheus, Grafana, and New Relic — for centralized logging, metrics, and alerting across all environments. – Autoscaling & Reliability: Implemented HPA and Cluster Autoscaler for dynamic Kubernetes scaling. – Cost Optimization: Designed AWS cost optimization strategies through right-sizing, efficient provisioning, and resource monitoring — achieving measurable reduction in operational cloud spend. – Configuration Management: Utilized Ansible to automate software provisioning and configuration of managed nodes, including security scan reporting.

entries.degree: •Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science and Engineering
